thread:
Alex Chang: Heads up — ACME's marketplace order is blocked by procurement. PO references an older billing entity (Redwood Inc) while our invoices use Redwood Inference LLC. Procurement won't accept until legal confirms signer authority. Need a quick triage, customer wants this by EOW.
Maria Gomez: Ugh. Can procurement share the exact PO PDF? last time it was a metadata mismatch that we could patch.
Ravi Patel: If we change the billing entity it triggers a new invoice flow on the marketplace side and probably a new tax form. That could add ~48h. What's the customer's hard deadline?
Alex Chang: They said end of week to hit Q2 numbers. They pushed this as a contingency in renewal conversation.
marketplace-bot: marketplace validation error: billing_entity_mismatch (MKT-409). See: https://console.marketplace/errors/MKT-409
Maria Gomez: Ok. Two parallel tracks: (1) Legal amendment to accept the old entity on this PO, (2) Finance checklist for new-entity onboarding. Jordan, can you draft amendment language we can send to ACME legal for signature?
Jordan Lee: I can. Quick Q: does ACME require countersignature from an authorized signatory, or will an acknowledgement email suffice? If countersign needed we should use DocuSign to speed it.
Alex Chang: I'll confirm with ACME legal now and DM you the contact. Uploading the PO to the shared folder: https://rwd.drive/acme_po_195123.pdf
Alex Chang: (snippet of PO header pasted) ```PO#: 9876543
BillingEntity: Redwood Inc
Signer: John D. CEO
Amount: $425,000
Term: 12 months``` 
Ravi Patel: Finance: if we accept the PO under Redwood Inc we need historical tax docs + a current W-9. If we move to Redwood Inference LLC, marketplace will re-issue invoices under the new entity and that will need a fresh merchant onboarding. Both routes have tradeoffs.
Maria Gomez: Any temporary workaround? Could we accept the PO under Redwood Inc and mark invoicing to Redwood Inference LLC internally, then reconcile? Risky for audit.
Jordan Lee: Audit risk is real. My proposed path: draft a narrow amendment saying "for the purposes of this PO only, Redwood Inference LLC is an affiliate of Redwood Inc and authorized to fulfill." That keeps the customer's PO intact and gives us a legal cover. I can fast-track and request ACME to sign via DocuSign. Need contact + confirmation that ACME legal will accept affiliate language.
marketplace-bot: note: marketplace will still flag entity mismatch until paperwork is uploaded; amendment alone won't clear automated validations.
Alex Chang: Action items: Jordan drafts amendment (due today 5pm PT), Ravi compiles finance onboarding checklist (W-9, TIN confirmation, invoice mapping), Maria coordinates with marketplace ops to queue manual override if docs are uploaded. I'll ping ACME legal and ask for DocuSign turnaround. 
Maria Gomez: tagging @marketplace-ops to standby for manual validation once docs land. :eyes:
Ravi Patel: I'll get W-9 ready and estimate time to completion. If ACME signs amendment today, finance can clear in ~24h.
Jordan Lee: Draft started. Will share comments in this thread and send DocuSign link once ready. 
Alex Chang: Thanks all — please post updates here. If anyone hears from ACME legal, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Got it. 
Ravi Patel: On it.
marketplace-bot: ticket created: MKT-2024-ACME-195123 (manual review queued).
